name: nexa
description: NEXA — the intelligent operating system for modern small businesses.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexa/api" "npm run dev -w @nexa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexa/api && npm run build -w @nexa/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
